rows.summary: Zully Broussard donated a kidney to a stranger, leading to six patients receiving transplants. The success was enabled by data analysis of genetic profiles. The surgeries involved multiple medical professionals and were part of a larger organ donation initiative.
On April 6, 1996, the first Major League Soccer match was played in San Jose. The league has grown significantly, expanding to 20 teams by 2015, with more set to join by 2020.

Bafetimbi Gomis collapsed during Swansea's match against Tottenham but was conscious after treatment. He was wearing an oxygen mask and spent the night in hospital as a precaution. Gomis has scored two league goals for Swansea this season.
